reservation.sql: INSERT OR IGNORE INTO report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow(reservation_id,day_utc,reserve_rows_read,reserve_rows_written,state,started_ts) SELECT ?1,?2,10000,5000,'RESERVED',?3 WHERE COALESCE((SELECT SUM(reserve_rows_read) FROM report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow WHERE day_utc=?2),0)+10000<=3500000 AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(reserve_rows_written) FROM report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow WHERE day_utc=?2),0)+5000<=70000 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow WHERE day_utc=?2 AND state='FINALIZED' AND COALESCE(unknown_ops,1)>0) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report2_runner_budget_ledger_shadow WHERE day_utc=?2 AND reservation_id LIKE 'CODEX_NATIVE_ROLE_INDEX:%')<1
